purpose: define the canonical conversion between Rakuten MT4 server timestamps and UTC for all new USDJPY baseline, architecture-atlas, candidate and validation evidence

source_facts.server_clock_transition_evidence: accepted 2023 native Rakuten MT4 HST maintenance-boundary audit

canonical_conversion.summer_start: last Sunday in March at 01:00 UTC
canonical_conversion.summer_end: last Sunday in October at 01:00 UTC
canonical_conversion.algorithm: construct both UTC+2 and UTC+3 candidates; require exactly one candidate to satisfy the frozen Europe/EET-EEST interval

separate_trading_schedule_rule.rule: the pre-Asian low-liquidity hard exclusion follows Rakuten trading-hour notices and US DST schedule
separate_trading_schedule_rule.reason: trading-hour schedule and server-clock offset are different mechanisms and must not share one DST selector

historical_candidate_policy.reason: a closed preregistered specification remains closed; the foundational correction applies prospectively to all new research
historical_candidate_policy.required_before_cross_year_use: rebuild session labels, trade keys, entry-state fields and dependent diagnostics under this canonical contract
